name: Kling female — original video
provenance:
User-supplied Kling source artwork. Imported through the external Gathria Unified CharacterPack 1.0.0 contract. Each native-resolution RGBA frame is packed without resampling, thresholding, recoloring or regeneration; duplicate pixels share atlas cells while frame order and FPS remain intact. Clothing, body and shoes are baked together. This is not an editable skeletal or wardrobe identity. Source action selection is a loop candidate, not final artistic acceptance. The optional jump is a forward one-shot source sequence, not a looping or synthesized pose.

Sprite action settings adjusted from the preserved source CharacterPack. Only contiguous clip selection, FPS and loop/one-shot metadata changed. Every original atlas PNG byte, frame rectangle, source-frame/time mapping and anchor is retained; playback timing may now differ from source video timing.

derivation.method:
exact-rgba-atlas-v1

Sprite action settings adjusted from the preserved source CharacterPack. Only contiguous clip selection, FPS and loop/one-shot metadata changed. Every original atlas PNG byte, frame rectangle, source-frame/time mapping and anchor is retained; playback timing may now differ from source video timing.

notes: Zero-based decoded video frame indices. Every selected frame is played forward once at the original 24 fps; no duplicated endpoint, ping-pong, interpolation or morphing.
Fixed per-character crop only. No scaling, per-frame recentering, stabilization, skeleton fitting, repainting or facial correction.
Ground anchor is a fixed reference near the standing soles, not a per-frame foot lock or anatomical measurement.
Background alpha is estimated from each source green-screen profile. Only partially transparent edge RGB is unmixed/despilled; every fully opaque pixel retains decoded source RGB exactly.
Original source motion blur, pose variation and small cycle mismatch remain visible. These are reviewed loop candidates, not user-approved final animation.
Jump is a single forward performance, source frames171–209 inclusive at24fps, then holds its final frame. No celebration frames substitute for jump.

All frames gain32 transparent canvas pixels above the old crop; anchor moves by the same32pixels. Existing four actions retain identical RGBA after removing this padding. No visible artwork is shifted relative to its anchor.
The original videos cut a small scalp arc at source frames183–186. New canvas includes every source pixel but cannot reconstruct artwork missing from the video.
